description: This file defines the IBasketService interface, which declares methods related to basket management such as transferring, adding items, setting quantities, and deleting a basket in an e-commerce application.

classes.name: IBasketService
classes.description: Interface declaring basket operations for the e-commerce application.

methods.name: TransferBasketAsync
methods.description: Transfers basket contents from an anonymous user to an identified user.

methods.name: AddItemToBasket
methods.description: Adds an item to the user's basket with specified catalog item ID, price, and quantity.

methods.name: SetQuantities
methods.description: Sets quantities for items in the basket, identified by basket ID and a dictionary of product IDs to quantities.

methods.name: DeleteBasketAsync
methods.description: Deletes a basket by its ID.
